en.texto: A case doesn't close because you close it. It stays open. In you.

en.texto: Something in your verification has no name. I'll give it yours.

en.texto: The portal keeps every click. Your clicks had no order. They had fear.

en.texto: I printed your chat. Underlined in red, so it shows from afar.

en.texto: A chat. You thought writing can't be heard. Here everything is heard.

es.texto: Otro chat tuyo. Ya reconozco tus pausas entre mensaje y mensaje.

en.texto: Another chat of yours. I already recognize your pauses between messages.

es.texto: Volví a abrir tu chat. Seguía ahí. Esperándote. Como el cliente.

es.texto: Leí tus mensajes en voz alta. Sonaban como tú. Eso es lo peor.

en.texto: I read your messages aloud. They sounded like you. That's the worst part.

es.texto: Tu último chat. Léelo conmigo. Tú escribiste esto. Con esas manos.

en.texto: Your last chat. Read it with me. You wrote this. With those hands.

en.texto: I printed your email. I have it here. It smells of hurry.

en.texto: One email. Writing has no tone of voice, they say. It does. I hear it.

es.texto: Otro correo tuyo. Ya reconozco tu manera de no releer.

en.texto: Another email of yours. I already recognize your way of not rereading.

es.texto: Abrí tu caso otra vez. Tu borrador seguía caliente.

en.texto: I opened your case again. Your draft was still warm.

es.texto: Tu correo llegó a su destino. A mí también me llegó. Siempre me llegan.

en.texto: Your email reached its destination. It reached me too. They always do.

es.texto: Tu último correo. Ya no hace falta que lo envíes. Ya lo leí yo.

en.texto: Your last email. You don't need to send it. I already read it.

es.texto: Cierro la puerta. El caso sigue abierto. Tú no.

en.texto: I'm closing the door. The case stays open. You don't.

en.texto: Your identity check. You looked at a face. I looked at you.

en.texto: A KYC. Deciding who is who. Almost nobody does it right.

es.texto: Otro KYC tuyo. Otra cara que no conoces. Otra decisión.

en.texto: Another KYC of yours. Another face you don't know.

es.texto: Abrí tu verificación. La foto seguía mirando a la cámara. A ti.

en.texto: I opened your check. The photo still stared at the camera. At you.

es.texto: Tu última verificación. Ahora me toca a mí verificar quién eres.

en.texto: Your last verification. Now it's my turn to verify who you are.

es.texto: Siéntate. Escuchemos tu llamada. Yo ya la oí. Varias veces.

en.texto: Sit down. Let's hear your call. I already did. Several times.

es.texto: Tengo tu llamada en el oído. Ahora la vas a tener tú.

en.texto: I've had your call in my ear. Now you'll have it too.

es.texto: Una llamada. Una sola. Es increíble todo lo que cabe en una sola llamada.

en.texto: One call. Just one. It's amazing how much fits in a single call.

es.texto: Otra llamada tuya. Ya sé cómo tomas aire antes de contestar.

en.texto: Another call of yours. I know how you breathe before answering.

es.texto: Volvemos a tu voz. Me la sé mejor que tú.

en.texto: Back to your voice. I know it better than you do.

es.texto: Esta llamada la puse en bucle. No me cansé. Eso debería preocuparte.

en.texto: I put this call on a loop. I didn't get tired. That should worry you.

es.texto: Tu última llamada. Es la última vez que vas a oír tu voz así.

en.texto: Your last call. It's the last time you'll hear your voice like this.

es.texto: Cierro la puerta. Ahora solo estamos tú, yo y tu llamada.

en.texto: I'm closing the door. Now it's just you, me and your call.

en.texto: Sit down. Your Vitzo case. The portal, the email, all of it.

en.texto: A Vitzo case. There's one way in. You went in another way.

es.texto: Otra vez Vitzo. A él no le gusta que lo hagan esperar. A mí tampoco.

en.texto: Vitzo again. He doesn't like to be kept waiting. Neither do I.

en.texto: Your portal case. I opened it. The portal opened me too.

en.texto: Your last Vitzo case. He's listening. He always listens.

en.texto: You approved. Someone who isn't who they say got in. They're inside.

en.texto: Approved, you said. Without checking the date. It doesn't exist.

es.texto: Escalaste lo que era tuyo. Subirlo no te sube. Te deja conmigo.

en.texto: You escalated what was yours. That leaves you down here. With me.

en.texto: You rejected someone one document short. It's raining outside.

en.texto: Rejecting is easy. One click. Behind the click was a person.

es.texto: Resolviste un recheck que no era. Sigue abierto. Te mira.

en.texto: You resolved the wrong recheck. It stays open. It watches you.

en.texto: You decided nothing. That identity was left hanging. Like yours.

en.texto: Another document, rule unread. It was on the right. It always is.

en.texto: "Calm down". Nobody calms down when told to. Neither will you.

en.texto: A password. The one thing nobody asks for. You asked kindly.

en.texto: You promised without looking at the screen. I collect promises.

es.texto: Lo escribiste sin revisar. Esa promesa se queda aquí. Conmigo.

en.texto: You typed it without checking. That promise stays here. With me.

es.texto: Prometiste sin saber. Alguien lo espera despierto. Como tú.

en.texto: You answered what everyone answers. Here everyone ends the same.

en.texto: You answered before checking. I check everything before I call you.

en.texto: You replied without opening Kardex. It was right there. Waiting.

en.texto: You didn't look. You said "done" without looking. I looked.

en.texto: "It depends". "A while". "We'll see". Who is we? Say it slowly.

en.texto: You transferred for no reason. To a queue that doesn't exist. Listen.

en.texto: Another queue, in chat. Six minutes alone. I read every dot.
